# CreatePhysicsSliderConstraint <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreatePhysicsSliderConstraint:Int32 a:Int32, b:Int32, axis_x:Float32, axis_y:Float32, axis_z:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | In | Int32 | required | The first body (a physics body entity). Limits, angles, speeds and positions of the constraint are those of this body relative to the second. |
| `b` | In | Int32 | required | The second body, or 0 to hold the first body against the world. |
| `axis_x` | In | Float32 | required | The direction of the axis, x. It does not have to be of length 1, but not 0. |
| `axis_y` | In | Float32 | required | The direction of the axis, y. |
| `axis_z` | In | Float32 | required | The direction of the axis, z. |

**Returns:** The handle of the constraint.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Lets the first body move along one axis only and not turn, like a piston or a drawer. Set the range with `PhysicsConstraintLimits`, drive it with `PhysicsConstraintMotor`, make the end stops soft with `PhysicsConstraintSpring`. Positions are measured from where the bodies are when the constraint is made.

A constraint needs bodies in the same physics world and at least one body that can move (dynamic). It is gone when either body is freed or the world is freed. All points and directions are in the world. Free it with `FreePhysicsConstraint`.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
